title: rosa longicruris
intro: Rosa longicruris, commonly known as the Long-horned Rose or Long-horned Wild Rose, is a plant species in the rose family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa longicruris include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its overall health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are still being researched for their potential health benefits.
